config.reference_comparison: Independently propagate each EXISTING RGB anchor to each focus frame using unchanged search/NCC/margin/roundtrip thresholds; save all attempts, including failures. config.sensitivity: On each ORIGINAL frame, hold q and union fixed: compare each same-frame dual-anchor reference and historical frame20 reference as a named scalar probe. Failed-localization attempts are diagnostic-only. No probe is adopted because it passes the area cap. Historical frame20 scalar is not a same-frame reference or truth.
config.spatial_proxies: Per component, separately count overlap with pre-existing input-defined head_context rectangle (mixed head/neck/background), body_core rectangle, and <=5-native-pixel subject boundary. Counts overlap and are not an anatomical partition. Component bbox/ID overlays allow user localization.

No continuous late-correction output exists; blur regression cause is not uniquely established.
